content.text: ‘SNL’ Sets Season 51 Cast: Colin Jost, Michael Che, Bowen Yang, Ego Nwodim and More to ReturnAhead of its October premiere, “Saturday Night Live” has set its Season 51 cast.The season will feature the return of established “SNL” cast members Bowen Yang, Ego Nwodim, Chloe Fineman, Mikey Day, Sarah Sherman, Marcello Hernández, Andrew Dismukes and resident Trump impersonator James Austin Johnson.
